name: 74604 · Ponca City, OK
findings: ZIP 74604 (Ponca City) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74604 (Ponca City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74604 (Ponca City) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
